title: CampsOnCampusPack
description: Modpack for the UNCC Camps On Campus Minecraft camp
body:
This modpack is used for the 2025 UNC Charlotte Camps on Campus Minecraft Redstone summer camp. It includes optimization mods to allow Minecraft to run on lower end machines and utilities that make building Redstone contraptions easier like Worldedit and Axiom. You can download this modpack if you want to play on our server at home.

It is based on the [Simply Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/sop) Modpack with the following additions:
- Worldedit
- Axiom
- Open Parties and Claims
- Redstone Tweaks
- Mod Menu
